defective_pattern: Dumping raw asterisks ** or LaTeX math delimiters $ directly into Word table cells.
why_defective: python-docx does not parse markdown inherently. Dumping raw delimiters results in literal '**text**' appearing in the final document, breaking formatting.
observed_symptoms: Literal '**' or '$' characters visible in DOCX table cells
corrective_remedy: Parse markdown and LaTeX delimiters explicitly before inserting text into python-docx cells, converting them to run properties (run.bold = True, etc.).

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Raw markdown injection into docx table cell text properties.
